name: #CitizenResponseBolivia
content: Problems and Purpose #CitizenResponseBolivia is a civil society initiative that was organized to disseminate official and verified information regarding COVID-19. This project seeks to combat misinformation regarding the Coronavirus by verifying news and data. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The initiative is open to the general public and interested parties can participate by sharing notes or information through a Telegram group.
